constraints: no provider source text, RFC member array or Objective impact rows

actions.rule: One row per WFM Task consequence written by RfcTerminalTaskParticipant.apply_terminal_cascade inside the caller LLD-03 UnitOfWork. It never copies RFC scope, provider source text or unbounded Objective impact rows.

payload_policy.rule: Audit payloads contain bounded immutable identifiers, exact plan/membership/review fingerprints, revisions, reason categories and result references. Immutable WFM source payloads stay in LLD-04 and physical Inventory facts stay in LLD-07.
payload_policy.no_change: Semantic NO_CHANGE never fabricates a new Task/Objective lifecycle or audit event.
payload_policy.privacy_and_authority: Audit JSON never becomes a competing Task plan, Objective envelope, Task execution/outcome, source-plan or Inventory authority.
